description: Image Description: The image displays a close-up view of a pile of donuts, arranged in a slightly overlapping manner. The donuts are coated with various types of glazes, including white, pink, and chocolate, and are generously topped with colorful sprinkles in shades of yellow, pink, and white. The texture of the donuts appears soft and slightly glossy due to the icing. Some donuts have a smooth, shiny surface, while others show a more matte finish. The background is blurred
